title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
abstract: arXiv:2610.32250v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality. Meanwhile, specialized 3D object generators provide detailed object geometry, while 3D foundation models offer strong and generalizable spatial understanding. We propose Easy-3Dfy, a compositional workflow that decouples object generation from scene layout estimation, allowing specialized models to fully exploit their respective strengths. An RPF-based aligner then bridges these capabilities by establishing geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, recovering object layout for scene composition. translated_title: Easy-3Dfy：面向单图像3D场景构建的物体级几何组合方法
translated_abstract: 单图像3D场景构建是3D视觉领域的一个基础问题。近期的方法（如SAM-3Dfy）能够对3D资产及其场景布局进行端到端重建，但在细粒度的场景几何和资产质量方面仍存在不足。与此同时，专用的3D物体生成器可以提供精细的物体几何，而3D基础模型则具备强大且可泛化的空间理解能力。我们提出Easy-3Dfy，这是一种组合式工作流程，将物体生成与场景布局估计解耦，使各专用模型能够充分发挥自身优势。随后，基于RPF的对齐器通过在物体局部网格与部分场景点图之间建立几何对应关系，将这些能力衔接起来，恢复物体的空间布局以完成场景组合。在无需完整场景级监督的情况下，所提出的工作流程在Scene-Maker等数据集的多个几何指标上均持续优于SAM-3Dfy。
tldr: Easy-3Dfy提出一种组合式工作流程，将专用物体生成与3D基础模型的场景布局估计解耦，并通过基于RPF的对齐器在物体网格与部分场景点图之间建立几何对应，无需完整场景级监督即可实现高质量的单图像3D场景构建，在多个几何指标上超越SAM-3Dfy。
en_tdlr: Easy-3Dfy decouples specialized object generation from scene layout estimation and uses an RPF-based aligner to establish geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, enabling high-quality single-image 3D scene construction without complete scene-level supervision while outperforming SAM-3Dfy across multiple geometric metrics.
